newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Family sees possible deal days away.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Family sees possible deal days away.

text.p: International Family Entertainment Inc Chairman Pat Robertson on Thursday said a deal involving the possible sale of the company may be several days away.
"Something may be coming up in the future," Robertson said. "I would like to see something in several days."
Recent newspaper reports have said the company, owner of the cable television network Family Channel, has been in discussions with News Corp Ltd as well as with Walt Disney Co.
Robertson declined to discuss whether either of those companies was involved in negotiations with International Family.
Robertson spoke to Reuters before a dinner sponsored UJA--Federation, a Jewish charity, to honor News Corp chairman Rupert Murdoch.
Earlier, shares of International Family closed up 7/8 at 27-7/8, a 52-week high.
